rust_summary: A server player swapped with an equipment slot (`native_player_swap_with_equipment_slot`).
doc_summary: A server player swapped their main hand with an equipment slot: `native_player_swap_with_equipment_slot(player, name, slot)` fires after both hands changed; `slot` is currently `offhand`. Guest lookup helpers may find nothing during packet handling. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_swap_with_equipment_slot@.
